ctx.x: And these kids and I would play together all the time. And one of these kinds, Frankie Rekuparo, we were such close friends as kids until he wanted to go to theater with me, and that was kind of taboo down South in those days. And Frankie -- we were kids, just young kids. And I worked for his father's grocery store delivering groceries. But they would help me deliver the groceries.

By anyway, one day I took Frankie and I put some charcoal dust all over his face -- I never forgot this when he was a little kid -- because he wanted to see a movie that was at the colored theater, the Star Theater at West Broad Street. And this was a picture with Tom Mix in it. I never forgot that. We loved cowboys, you know, in those days.
